_note: Written by scripts/art/ui/body_loot.mjs --pieces: do not edit by hand. A body's loot window (D248, D128): the loot window opened on someone lying where they fell, in the window's pixels, 1152 x 648; "at" is a top left corner, and a piece's "at" already counts its shadow. Draw in the order of "order"; text last. Text is drawn by Godot: "at" is the top left of the line (the top is the font's ascent line), "right" its top right, "centre" its top middle. Every place and size here is a setting. The window is one block on the right of the screen: in another window size it would keep to the right (not done).

slots._note: Each slot: "Slot <material>" at its place, the material of what it holds (Empty when nothing). The slot under the pointer, when it holds something: Slot Lit, its corner "lit" from the slot's. An item's pack picture (D237): the part "from" of the 256 x 256 picture, drawn "px" wide, its corner "picture" from the slot's. A count (coins, arrows, bandages: D124) right-aligned, its top right "count" from the slot's corner.

worn._note: What the body wore, in the character screen's gear order. An empty slot shows its gear name, centred, its top "name_dy" from the slot's top.

carried._note: What the body carried: a slot's corner is first + step times its column and row. 12 slots, 20 if it wore a backpack (D124).

pack._note: Your pack: 12 slots, 20 with a backpack (D124).

note._note: The note on the item under the pointer, shown only while a slot of the body that holds something is pointed at. Plate Note is drawn for the worn row: for a carried slot it goes down by that slot's top minus the worn row's top; its texts are placed from the plate's corner, which is at "corner" for the worn row.

take_all._note: Takes everything that fits (D142, D124), worn gear included: a click, or Space.

name._note: The body's description (D128): its name if you were told it, else what you saw of it. "title" when it does not fit in "mid" beside the free line.

free._note: A corpse's gear is free world loot (D3); the words are not decided.

pack._note: "Pack", then "filled / slots" "gap" after it; at the right, "Coins" then the coins, the coins right-aligned and "Coins" "gap" before them.
pack.label: label
